questions.explain: The RBI is really pushing for sustainability. By encouraging 'Green Deposits', they're ensuring that the money we save is channeled specifically into environmentally friendly projects, which is a massive step for our green transition.

questions.q: Which country recently signed the 'Deep Sea Mining Accord' with India to explore mineral-rich zones in the Indian Ocean?
questions.explain: Norway has been a pioneer in deep-sea tech. By partnering with them, India is looking to tap into the 'Blue Economy'—specifically for critical minerals like cobalt and nickel that we desperately need for our EV battery manufacturing.

questions.q: India's first commercial space station module is expected to be launched by which private entity in collaboration with ISRO?
questions.explain: Skyroot is really making waves! They've moved from launching small rockets to partnering on massive infrastructure like space modules. It shows how the private sector is becoming the backbone of our space dreams.

questions.q: The 'Global Hunger Index' 2025 results were released this week. Which factor was cited as the primary driver for India's improved ranking?
questions.explain: While there's a lot of debate around these indices, the report specifically highlighted the strengthening of the Public Distribution System (PDS). Better food security nets really do help in bringing down those hunger markers.

questions.q: Which city is hosting the COP30 climate summit discussions that have just commenced this November?
questions.explain: COP30 is happening in Belém, Brazil. It's a symbolic location because it's right in the heart of the Amazon rainforest. The focus this time is heavily on protecting biodiversity while balancing development.

questions.q: The 'Nari Shakti Bharat' scheme was recently expanded. Who is the primary target demographic for this financial assistance program?
questions.explain: This scheme is all about grassroots empowerment. By targeting rural women entrepreneurs, the government is trying to spark a small-scale industry revolution, which is just brilliant for economic decentralization.

questions.q: In the recently concluded World Chess Championship qualifiers, which Indian teenager made history by becoming the youngest finalist?

questions.q: Which Indian state has become the first to implement a '100% Water-Positive' rating for its industrial zones?
questions.explain: Gujarat has been very proactive with its industrial policy lately. A water-positive rating means the industry puts more water back into the ground than it extracts—it's a massive win for sustainability in manufacturing.

questions.q: The 'Global South Tech Alliance' was formed last week. Which country currently chairs this alliance?
questions.explain: India has taken the lead here to ensure technology isn't just a Western commodity. The idea is to share tech, especially digital public infrastructure, with other developing nations so everyone can grow together.
